title: The Lighthouse That Knitted the Fog
description: On the morning of the Fog Blessing, the lighthouse knits the harbor mist into a shawl. The boats leave their lamps lit until the last stitch is cast off.
alt: A lighthouse beams amber light over three moored boats as a cream shawl with a rust-and-green border dissolves into blue sea fog.
pairing: A coastal fog blessing × a lighthouse loom
